result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: a restaurant name truncated in the Fastest near you carousel, and the bottom nav Orders tab missing its icon.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width accommodates typical restaurant names without clipping.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab has no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which all show icons.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. receipt or bag) consistent with the other tab icons.
